permissionSummary.readOnly: Reads and plans. Every change is refused.
permissionSummary.ask: Asks before every action that is not a read.
permissionSummary.editsOnly: Reads and edits files without asking. Everything else asks.
permissionSummary.editsAndCommands: Reads, edits files and runs commands without asking. Other tools are refused.
permissionSummary.auto: The tool's own reviewed automatic mode decides. A tool without one asks, as in Supervised. Needs run administration.
permissionSummary.full: Nothing asks. Olivares still confines the session and records every action. Needs run administration.
